description: FCC auction pages blocked by egress proxy
impact: Cannot download official public notices, qualified bidder lists, or raw auction data files. Affects all 98 auctions.
workaround: Used v3 bids.json entities as proxy for qualified bidders; winner data from search snippets and v1 auction_results.json

description: Third-party telecom research sites blocked by egress proxy
impact: Limits cross-reference verification of auction details and company histories
workaround: Relied on v1 and v3 data stores plus available search engine snippets for verification

description: v3 bids.json stores 170 losing bids with bid_amount=0; actual amounts are not public
impact: Zero values misrepresent bid amounts. These are NOT zero-dollar bids; the actual losing bid amounts were not disclosed.
workaround: Corrected in auction-field/bids.json: bid_amount set to null with amount_public=false for all 170 affected rows

description: v3 auctions.json has source_url stripped from all 98 auctions (field present but empty or null)
impact: No provenance link to original FCC auction pages in v3 data
workaround: Reconstructed source_url values from v1 data in auction-field/auctions.json

description: v3 relationships.json has 784 edges but zero have source_url populated
impact: Cannot verify provenance of any relationship claim in the v3 graph. No way to trace edges back to original source documents.
workaround: None. Relationship claims carried forward without independent verification.

description: v1 auction_results.json has company_id=null on all 87 winner rows
impact: Requires name-matching to identify companies; no stable identifier linking winners to entity records
workaround: Resolved via identity_map.json cross-reference using legal_name and company_name matching

description: Qualified bidder data only available for 71 of 98 auctions (those with entries in v3 bids.json). 27 auctions have no bidder-level data in either v1 or v3.
impact: No bidder-level participation data for 27 auctions. Cannot analyze competitive dynamics or losing bidder behavior for these auctions.
workaround: None for the missing 27. Analysis limited to the 71 auctions with v3 bid records.

description: License-grain results only available for 15 of 98 auctions (those in v1 auction_results.json)
impact: Cannot analyze license-level outcomes, geographic distribution of wins, or per-license pricing for 83 auctions
workaround: Auction-level aggregates available for all 98 auctions in auctions.json; license-level detail limited to the 15 covered auctions

description: 276 of 652 v3 entities have no FRN (FCC Registration Number)
impact: Cannot be definitively cross-referenced to FCC records. Identity relies on name matching alone for these entities.
workaround: Name-based matching used where possible; entities without FRN flagged in identity_map.json

description: 13 duplicate legal_name values in v3 entities (different entity_ids, same name)
impact: Risk of false matches when joining on legal_name. Same company name may map to multiple entity records.
workaround: Flagged in identity_map.json. Consumers should use entity_id as primary key, not legal_name.

description: 214 v3 entities have no FRN and no v1 company match (match_rule=null in identity_map)
impact: These entities exist only in v3 with no external anchor. Cannot verify their identity or link them to any FCC filing.
workaround: Entities carried forward as-is from v3. Flagged in identity_map.json with match_rule=null.

description: This package was built without direct FCC source access. All field data derives from existing v1/v3 data stores plus search engine snippets.
impact: A proper field package would download and parse raw FCC CSV/TSV files directly from auctiondata.fcc.gov. This package is a best-effort reconstruction from secondary sources, not a primary-source compilation.
workaround: Package clearly labeled as derived data. All source provenance documented. Gaps.json (this file) serves as the transparency record.
